credibility.line: Management consistently achieves revenue growth and ROE targets (20.3%), but 5-year cash conversion remains low at 0.18.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: FY26 consolidated revenue rose 24.8% to ₹198,639 crore and PAT grew 32.3% to ₹18,622 crore, validating growth claims.
Reported ROE of 20.3% matches management's guidance to maintain group ROE around the 18% mark.
Despite reported PAT of ₹18,622 crore in FY26, OCF/PAT was 0.63 and 5-year cumulative cash conversion was just 0.18.

bull: FY26 annual revenue grew 24.8% to ₹198,639 crore with EBITDA margin reaching 19.0%.
Reported ROE of 20.3% exceeded management's long-term target of 18%.
Q1 FY27 PAT hit a record ₹5,998 crore, up 37.0% year-over-year.
bear: 5-year cumulative OCF/PAT ratio is poor at 0.18, with negative free cash flow in FY23-FY25.
Borrowings rose to ₹154,094 crore in Sep 2026, keeping leverage elevated at D/E 1.57.
EBIT margin contracted from 15.6% in Jun 2026 to 14.6% in Sep 2026.
watch: OCF/PAT cash conversion improvement from the 0.63 level reported in FY26.
Tech Mahindra EBIT margin progress toward the 15% target by end of FY27.
Total borrowings trajectory from ₹154,094 crore level in Sep 2026.
